summary: Conway’s enacted use table lists both Limited and General data centers as conditional in I-1 and as permitted (X) in I-3. The General designation is a secondary use and also conditional across the other listed districts; the Limited designation’s remaining cells are blank. Both definitions expressly cover digital asset mining.
locator: O-23-72 §1, permitted use table and §1302 definitions (pp. 1–2)

summary: For a data-center conditional use application, submit building plans, a noise study and a noise attenuation plan. Planning and Development staff can also request utility-use information.
evidence: Noise Study and a Noise Attenuation Plan
